newsitem.title: CHINA: Japan's Asahi Glass in $11 mln China deal.
newsitem.headline: Japan's Asahi Glass in $11 mln China deal.

text.p: Japan's Asahi Glass Co Ltd has signed a deal with the Jin Hua Chemical (Group) to supply the Chinese firm with $11 million worth of caustic soda production equipment, the China Daily newspaper said on Monday.

Jin Hua, based in Huludao in the northeastern province of Liaoning, had signed the contract at the weekend and would finance the deal partly with loans from the Asian Development Bank, the newspaper said.
The China National Chemical Construction Corp under the Ministry of Chemical Industry had helped to arrange the deal, it said.
The deal would boost Jin Hua's production of caustic soda through membrane processing to 80,000 tonnes a year, it said but gave no further details.
